title: Don’t Think, Just Sink
description:
A deliciously simple femdom hypnosis experience. As you listen to me take you into hypnotic trance, you'll be guided to repeat a mantra. Don't think, just sink.

You're probably thinking you've heard that before. But as your pleasure grows from the simple act of being entranced by me, you'll find we can make that mantra a little simpler. Until all you can do is sink, sink, sink for me.

And I know you'll enjoy that, your hypnotic Mistress taking you deep and pulling you down so far you don't know which way is up. All you can do is repeat after me, and let me take complete control of your mind. Let me in.

Art by Rielilu.
